uncertainty_note: Seed standard deviations describe three residual seeds on one shared frozen backbone. The zero control is one deterministic predictor, so its standard deviation is structural. User-sampling uncertainty is a separate bootstrap and is never merged with these.
comparison_6_note: F5 mean matched against F4 mean matched contrasts two information sources on one shared backbone. It is not an architecture comparison: retained length is 200 against 20, mean retained tokens about 185 against 4.69, and empty-history share about 0.44% against 30.21%.
no_reselection: No model, length, learning rate, donor or primary model changed.
